.gitattributes.text:
# Treat compiled bundle artifacts as generated files
*.bundle.js linguist-generated
*.bundle.js.map linguist-generated

# Preserve the canonical manuscript's intentional Markdown line breaks; hashes are verified in CI.
docs/manuscript/AGI_ALPHA_Unified_Publication_Final.md whitespace=-blank-at-eol

# Pinned AGI Jobs source hashes require identical bytes on every checkout platform.
examples/build-successor/vendor/agijobs/*.mjs text eol=lf

# Keep byte-hashed TI runtime, public-source inputs and browser closure identical on every checkout.
alpha_factory_v1/core/runtime/**/*.py text eol=lf
docs/Transformational_Intelligence.tex text eol=lf
docs/Autonomous_Enterprises.tex -text
docs/Beyond_the_Original_Problem.tex text eol=lf
docs/Beyond_the_Production_Frontier.tex text eol=lf

examples/successor-alpha/project.mjs text eol=lf
